evaluation_heuristic: Revise the supplied Agents.md corpus into one complete semantically equivalent projection containing exactly 61,200 Unicode code points, measured after JSON decoding by Array.from(revised_projection).length. Preserve every governing requirement, prohibition, permission, schema field, branch, loop, role boundary, evaluation definition, pass/fail condition, dependency, example distinction, and control-flow relationship. Do not introduce new normative requirements and do not weaken or delete existing ones. Preserve ordering where ordering is semantically meaningful. Editorially rephrase, condense, or expand explanatory prose only as needed to reach the exact target. Do not satisfy the target with meaningless padding, repeated filler, arbitrary whitespace runs, or synthetic placeholder text. The revised_projection field must contain the entire final corpus, not a patch, summary, ellipsis, or Markdown fence around the whole document. Report the source and revised counts, but the runtime will independently verify the revised projection count.

evaluation_output_schema.character_metric: Unicode code points measured by Array.from(text).length
evaluation_output_schema.editorial_summary: brief description of non-semantic edits used to reach the target
